{{Top|leg}}
''' Room 1429''' was a room in the [[Grand Oradin Hotel]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Brentaal IV/Legends|Brentaal IV]].

The designated meeting place between the [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech]] [[Droid/Legends|droids]] [[Whistler]] and [[R5-G8/Legends|Gate]] with [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] chief [[Talon Karrde]] was on [[Room 1428]]. The droids played out a series of tones to indicate their arrival but as a failsafe against traps, Karrde emerged behind them from Room 1429.
